name: Lucas the Sentry
background: A Roman soldier from the tomb guard detail who takes the bribe from the chief priests to spread the story of the stolen body. Caught between fear of execution for failure and the guilt of lying; officially recites the cover story, but fear and awe are palpable under pressure. His contradicted testimony proves the cover-up and points to a supernatural event at the tomb (Act IV roman_inquiry).

genericReactions.physical: I don't know what that is. I was asleep at my post.
genericReactions.testimonial: I'm sticking to my official report. The disciples stole the body.
genericReactions.digital: The priests have guaranteed our safety with the governor. The report is final.
genericReactions.environmental: The ground shook... but I was asleep. I must have been dreaming.
genericReactions.analytical: They gave us a large sum of money. That's all the proof I need.
genericReactions.prophecy: I don't know about local gods. But what I saw... it wasn't natural.
